item.title: Beach Boys Reschedule Remaining Summer 2026 North American Tour Dates to Allow Singer Mike Love to ‘Recharge’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Music: A quick clip of a Beach Boys song, followed by a smooth transition to the host]
Host: "Hey there, music fans! If you're looking forward to catching the Beach Boys on their summer tour, you'll have to wait a little longer. The band has just announced that they're hitting pause on their tour to allow singer Mike Love some time to recharge."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Love, who's 85 years young, posted the announcement on his Instagram page, saying that the break will give the band a chance to catch their breath before getting back on the road in September. And don't worry, all tickets for the postponed shows will still be honored when the band returns."
[Music transitions to a quick clip of the Beach Boys' 'God Only Knows']
Host: "This comes after a busy summer of touring, including a recent show in New Jersey where Love was reviewed as looking a bit under the weather. But the band is looking forward to getting back out there and celebrating the 60th anniversary of their iconic album, Pet Sounds, as well as the 250th anniversary of the United States."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "The Beach Boys will kick off their fall tour on September 24th in West Springfield, Massachusetts, with a string of dates across the country. We'll have the full list of rescheduled tour dates on our website, so be sure to check those out if you're a fan."
[Music transitions to a final clip of a Beach Boys song]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we can't wait to see the Beach Boys back on the road, bringing their legendary sound to a city near you. Until next time, stay musical!"
[Music fades out]
